bridge.exposition:
# HELP autopilot_events_received_total Glidepath events the trigger bridge handled, by how they arrived.
# TYPE autopilot_events_received_total counter
autopilot_events_received_total{via="recent"} 1
autopilot_events_received_total{via="stream"} 2
# HELP autopilot_events_stream_connected 1 while the bridge holds glidepath-api's event stream.
# TYPE autopilot_events_stream_connected gauge
autopilot_events_stream_connected 1
# HELP autopilot_events_last_received_timestamp_seconds Unix time the bridge last handled an event.
# TYPE autopilot_events_last_received_timestamp_seconds gauge
autopilot_events_last_received_timestamp_seconds 1.73159e+09
# HELP autopilot_events_cursor_timestamp_seconds Receive time carried by the bridge's saved cursor (the newest event id handled).
# TYPE autopilot_events_cursor_timestamp_seconds gauge
autopilot_events_cursor_timestamp_seconds 1.73159e+09
# HELP autopilot_events_resume_total Catch-ups from the saved cursor at (re)connect, by result: caught-up, stale-cursor (older than glidepath-api's buffer: events may be gone), failed.
# TYPE autopilot_events_resume_total counter
autopilot_events_resume_total{result="caught-up"} 1
autopilot_events_resume_total{result="stale-cursor"} 1
# HELP autopilot_trigger_outcomes_total What a trigger firing became, per agent, by path and result.
# TYPE autopilot_trigger_outcomes_total counter
autopilot_trigger_outcomes_total{agent="a\"b\\c\nd",via="reconcile",result="braked"} 3
autopilot_trigger_outcomes_total{agent="triage-agent",via="stream",result="deduped"} 1
autopilot_trigger_outcomes_total{agent="triage-agent",via="stream",result="launched"} 1
# HELP autopilot_trigger_missed_total Trigger firings no event delivered, found by the reconciliation sweep (the gap), by what the sweep decided: launched, or held, braked, refused, launch-failed.
# TYPE autopilot_trigger_missed_total counter
autopilot_trigger_missed_total{agent="triage-agent",result="launched"} 1
# HELP autopilot_reconcile_sweeps_total Reconciliation sweeps, by result (ok, failed).
# TYPE autopilot_reconcile_sweeps_total counter
autopilot_reconcile_sweeps_total{result="failed"} 2
autopilot_reconcile_sweeps_total{result="ok"} 1
# HELP autopilot_reconcile_last_success_timestamp_seconds Unix time of the last reconciliation sweep that read glidepath-api's run records.
# TYPE autopilot_reconcile_last_success_timestamp_seconds gauge
autopilot_reconcile_last_success_timestamp_seconds 1.73159e+09
# HELP autopilot_schedule_launches_total Interval slots fired, per agent, by result.
# TYPE autopilot_schedule_launches_total counter
# HELP autopilot_schedule_missed_total Interval slots whose grace window passed with no firing (the gateway was down).
# TYPE autopilot_schedule_missed_total counter
# HELP autopilot_schedule_lag_seconds Seconds between the start of an agent's last fired slot and its firing.
# TYPE autopilot_schedule_lag_seconds gauge
